meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Egypt (National Unitary Jurisdiction; GAFI One-Stop-Shop, Cairo)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil law system rooted in French-inspired codes and influenced by Islamic Sharia as a principal source of legislation; UNCITRAL-model commercial arbitration recognized
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Egypt-China Bilateral Investment Treaty (signed 1996, in force 1996)
Egypt-USA Bilateral Investment Treaty (signed 1982, in force 1986)
Arab League Unified Agreement for the Investment of Arab Capital in the Arab States (1980)
Egypt-EU Association Agreement (2004) with free-trade provisions

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 as amended by Law No. 4 of 2018, with Executive Regulations (Ministerial Decree No. 96 of 1982, as amended); Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 as amended by Law No. 160 of 2022, Executive Regulations (Prime Ministerial Decree No. 2310 of 2017); AML/CFT Law No. 80 of 2002 as amended by Laws No. 36 of 2014, No. 36 of 2019, and No. 24 of 2024, Executive Regulations (Prime Ministerial Decree No. 1703 of 2021); Central Bank of Egypt KYC/AML Instructions under Banking Law No. 194 of 2020; Financial Regulatory Authority UBO Register Decision No. 121 of 2019 and EMLCU implementing circulars; Hague Apostille accession approved by Law No. 20 of 2021, effective in Egypt from 14 December 2022

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of passport and specimen signature of each foreign UBO and appointed manager/director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public or national identity issuing authority in the UBO's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille issued by the competent authority of the origin country; if the origin state is not party to the 1961 Hague Convention, Egyptian Embassy consular legalization in that country is mandatory

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing or Certificate of Incumbency of any foreign corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Official company registry of the shareholder's home jurisdiction (e.g., Companies House, Secretary of State, Hong Kong Companies Registry)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (valid in Egypt since 14 December 2022) or consular legalization at the Egyptian diplomatic mission for non-Hague states

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board resolution of the foreign corporate shareholder authorizing incorporation of the Egyptian LLC and appointing its local representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public or corporate secretary of the foreign shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Egyptian consular legalization in accordance with the origin jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized landlord consent to the Egyptian registered office address (Arabic language)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Egyptian Notary Public Office (Shahr El Togary)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Domestic Egyptian notarization only; no apostille or consular process required for a domestic document

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-incorporation screening of all UBOs, directors, and authorized signatories against: (i) the EMLCU consolidated watch list and designated-persons lists issued under the Egyptian Counterterrorism Law No. 94 of 2015 and Law No. 80 of 2002; (ii) the United Nations Security Council Consolidated List (Resolutions 1267/1988/2231 and successor instruments); (iii) the OFAC SDN list, required for USD-denominated payment rails such as Shopify Payments and Stripe; and (iv) the EU Consolidated Sanctions List. PEP status must be classified in accordance with FATF Recommendation 12 and documented in a written AML risk assessment retained in the corporate file; any positive hit requires an immediate Suspicious Transaction Report (STR) to the Egyptian Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Combating Unit (EMLCU) and the name clearance/incorporation process must be suspended.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Istart Egypt digital one-stop-shop (istart.gov.eg) administered by the General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI), with fallback at the GAFI investor services center in Cairo
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The registered trade name of an Egyptian LLC must be in Arabic pursuant to the Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 and the Commercial Registry rules. A Latin-script transliteration may be adopted for banks, customs, and international payment providers, but it must be a phonetic transliteration of the Arabic name and may not carry a materially different meaning. All foreign-language incorporation documents, including apostilled records, must be accompanied by certified Arabic translations before GAFI will accept them for name booking.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Bank, Finance, Trust, Insurance, Reinsurance, Funds, Clearing, Payment - each requires prior licensing by the Central Bank of Egypt or the Financial Regulatory Authority
Islamic, Jihad, Quds, and sacred or religious references - contrary to public order under Article 5 of the Companies Law
National, Central, Governmental, Presidential, Arab Republic of Egypt, or other state-institution references - require written ministerial consent
Names identical or deceptively similar to a registered Egyptian company, an existing trademark, or a famous foreign brand
Suffixes including Holding, Group, or International where the corporate structure or business scope does not substantiate them
Joint-stock company markers such as S.A.E. where the legal form is an LLC - the name must carry the LLC designation (Limited Liability Company)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Name rejection is issued electronically by GAFI with a stated reason code. The applicant may immediately resubmit an alternative name without additional government fee. A formal written reconsideration, attaching any supporting trademark certificate or justification, may be filed through the Istart portal within 10 business days of the rejection. If GAFI maintains the refusal, the applicant may file an administrative grievance before the GAFI complaint committee and, ultimately, petition the Administrative Economic Court within 60 days of the final administrative decision.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A purely virtual mailbox is not recognized as an adequate head office under Executive Regulations of Companies Law No. 159 of 1981. A managed serviced office physically located in Cairo may be accepted for a commercial trading LLC, but the premises must be capable of hosting the original memorandum of association, minute books, commercial books, and the UBO register. For the stated PBT injection-molding activity, a conventional serviced office will not satisfy the physical-presence test for manufacturing operations, and a distinct registered industrial or warehouse address is advisable at the operative stage.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Moderate. Estimated 40% probability of an unannounced physical inspection within the first 12 months, triggered primarily by the Commercial Registry or General Tax Authority address verification during tax-card issuance, GAFI post-incorporation compliance review, or municipal industrial inspection. The likelihood increases to approximately 60% if the registered office documents are perceived as irregular or if the registered address is a pure virtual mailbox.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory fee schedule, Article 48 of the Executive Regulations of Investment Law No. 72 of 2017

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Hague Apostille legalization package for three corporate UBO documents (Certificate of Good Standing, Board Resolution, Passport Specimen) including commercial courier
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Competent Apostille authority of the document origin state (e.g., US Department of State, China Ministry of Foreign Affairs, HK High Court)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Nominal per-document apostille tariff (e.g., US $8/document, Hong Kong HK$125/document) plus prevailing commercial courier benchmark

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified Arabic translation of the apostilled corporate documents and incorporator identification file (approx. 8-12 pages at EGP 200-300 per page)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed Arabic translation office in Cairo
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing Egyptian legal-market rate for certified notarized translations

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: GAFI One-Stop-Shop statutory incorporation package (commercial registration entry, company data card, company seals, and publication in the Official Gazette)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory GAFI government fee schedule under Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 and Companies Law No. 159 of 1981, variable by capital and activity

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarial authentication of the memorandum of association and shareholders' specimen signatures before the Cairo Notary Public Office including stamped excerpts
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary Public Office (Shahr El Togary), Ministry of Justice
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Notarial tariff under the Egyptian Notaries Law and applicable ministerial fee schedule (approx. EGP 2,500)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office: first-quarter paid serviced office with landlord's notarized consent and building signboard installation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Commercial market benchmark for business-grade serviced offices in Cairo; satisfies the executive-regulation physical-presence test

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for boutique corporate firms in Cairo, reflecting an estimated 50-70 billable hours including fixed-fee incorporation coordination

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 (as amended by Law No. 4 of 2018), Part 3 - Limited Liability Companies, Articles 60-99; Investment Law No. 72 of 2017; Commercial Law No. 17 of 1999 (Commercial Registry); and Executive Regulations of Law No. 159/1981.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) - Investor Services Center, Companies Registration Department, and the Commercial Registry (Ministry of Justice).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Notarized contract of incorporation: 'Aqd Ta'sis' (Memorandum of Association) and 'Al-Nizam Al-Asasi' (Articles of Association), authenticated before a public notary.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for an LLC under Law No. 159 of 1981; the share capital must be fully subscribed at formation, and the cash portion must be deposited in a licensed Egyptian bank and evidenced by a banker's certificate. Capital may be paid in cash or in kind based on audited valuations.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, at the first organizational meeting of the founding members of [Company] LLC: 1. The certified Memorandum and Articles of Association are adopted; the initial EGP 50,000 capital, divided into 5,000 subscribed nominal shares, is ratified as fully taken up. 2. The registered office is established at [Address], Cairo, Egypt, and the lease approved. 3. [Name] is appointed General Manager, sole bank signatory; [Name] is appointed Corporate Secretary. 4. The General Manager is authorized to deposit the capital, notarize the contract, register with GAFI and the Commercial Registry, obtain tax, insurance and labor registrations, open the bank account, and procure all industrial, environmental and Civil Defense permits.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI Electronic Services Portal (Name Reservation Service)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit one online application listing three name options in Arabic and English. GAFI screens the proposed names against the Commercial Registry database and protected trademarks. Issue of the name reservation certificate confirms availability for 60 days.
required_dossiers: Online name reservation form
Valid passport or national ID of each founding partner
Power of attorney with official stamp (if an agent is acting)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Submit new name alternatives within 30 days; or file a written objection to GAFI Name Committee with trademark/prior-use evidence.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Bank Capital Deposit and Banker's Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Egyptian commercial bank (e.g., National Bank of Egypt, Banque Misr)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary 'company in formation' account using the name reservation certificate and the signed draft incorporation contract. Deposit the subscribed cash capital and obtain the banker's certificate stating the deposit amount, account number, and account holder names, which must accompany the GAFI filing.
required_dossiers: Name reservation certificate
Draft Memorandum and Articles of Association
Passport/ID of each partner or authorized proxy
Bank KYC forms and source-of-funds declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If KYC queries arise, provide supplementary source-of-wealth evidence (bank statements, commercial records) within 10 working days; alternatively deposit at another licensed bank.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public Department, Egyptian Ministry of Justice
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene all founding partners (or their duly authorized proxies) at the notary office. The notary verifies identities, witnesses the signatures on the Memorandum and Articles of Association, confirms the capital declarations, and attaches the official authentication seal, rendering the contract legally binding.
required_dossiers: Final signed Arabic Memorandum and Articles of Association
Name reservation certificate
Banker's capital deposit certificate
Passports/National IDs of partners or proxies
Powers of attorney bearing the notarized signatures of principals
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Corrections of clerical errors are made by a supplementary addendum signed by all partners; if any signature is challenged, re-authenticate with the same notary after curing the deficiency.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: GAFI Incorporation Filing and Commercial Registry Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI Investor Services Center (One-Stop Shop) / Companies Registration Department
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the notarized incorporation contract and annexes with GAFI for legal review. Upon approval, GAFI issues the incorporation decision and registers the company in the Commercial Registry, thereby issuing the Commercial Registration Certificate and automatically notifying the Egyptian Tax Authority, social insurance, and labor offices of the new entity.
required_dossiers: Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association
Name reservation certificate
Banker's capital deposit certificate
Lease contract or ownership deed of the registered office
Board resolution appointing managers and bank signatories
Passport/ID copies of the General Manager and Secretary
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Answer GAFI objections in writing within 30 days; if rejected, appeal to the GAFI Grievance Committee within 15 days of the refusal notice, then to the competent Administrative Court.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration - Tax Card, VAT and Payroll Files
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) - local tax office / e-invoicing portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for the electronic Tax Card (income tax file), VAT registration certificate under Value Added Tax Law No. 67 of 2016, and salary/payroll tax file. The Tax Card must be issued within one business day of the ETA receiving Commercial Registry data; the VAT number also permits e-invoicing/e-receipt system activation for invoicing customers.
required_dossiers: Commercial Registration Certificate
Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association
Lease contract or proof of address
Manager appointment resolution and ID
ETA tax card application form
VAT registration application (Form No. 5/67)
Utility bill confirming factory/office address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Tax Card is delayed beyond one business day after registry data transfer, submit a formal ETA complaint; a provisional certificate must be issued while the file is reviewed. VAT registration can be expedited through the ETA large taxpayer or middle taxpayer centers.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Social Insurance, Labor Office and Employer Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Organization for Social Insurance (NASS) and Ministry of Manpower Labor Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the LLC as an employer: submit Form 1 (employer declaration) and Form 2 (employee roster) at the competent NASS office, and file the establishment notification with the Labor Office. Obtain the NASS employer number and the workplace safety/health clearance file, prerequisites for hiring staff.
required_dossiers: Commercial Registration Certificate
Tax Card
Memorandum and Articles of Association
GM appointment contract and national ID/passport
NASS Forms 1 and 2 (Arabic statutory forms)
Workshop/factory lease and Civil Defense report (if available)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Late registration can be cured under NASS settlement procedures by paying nominal fines; file all delinquent forms and pay contributions to obtain a clean NASS clearance before commencing social insurance inspections.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Industrial Development Authority (IDA) - Industrial Licensing Department, coordinated with GAFI One-Stop Shop
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Industrial Operating License under the Industrial Licensing Law No. 15 of 2017, issued for the production line covering double-shot PBT plastic injection molding of custom mechanical keyboard keycaps; submission is made electronically through the IDA industrial licensing platform, with deemed approval if no technical objection is raised within 30 calendar days.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Egyptian Environmental Affairs Agency (EEAA) - Environmental Permits and Compliance Department
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category B (B2) - Limited Environmental Impact Assessment / Environmental Screening Form (Form B), submitted prior to commissioning the injection molding line; small-capacity plastics molding units located inside designated industrial zones may qualify for the registration-level screening route under Law No. 4 of 1994 and Executive Regulation No. 338 of 1995 as amended.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater to public sewer per Decree No. 44 of 2000: pH 6.5-9.5, TSS not exceeding 300 mg/L, BOD not exceeding 300 mg/L, COD not exceeding 600 mg/L; air emissions per Executive Regulation No. 338 of 1995 and Decree No. 964 of 2015: particulate matter not exceeding 100 mg/Nm3, process VOCs from injection and cleaning captured by local exhaust and treated by activated carbon to applicable odor/VOC thresholds; plastic scrap, regrind and oil residues must be handed to EEAA-licensed waste contractors under Waste Management Regulation Law No. 202 of 2020, with a waste manifest register.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Civil Defense fire safety certification from the General Administration of Civil Defense (Ministry of Interior) after on-site inspection of the factory (fire extinguishers, evacuation routes, alarms, storage of plastic polymer raw materials); occupational workplace clearance from the Ministry of Manpower Industrial Safety Department under Labor Law No. 12 of 2003: machine guarding on injection molding presses, extraction ventilation, personal protective equipment, and noise exposure within applicable limits (90 dB A / 8-hour shift); plus structural and building permit inspection clearance under the Unified Building Law No. 119 of 2008 covering the production hall load-bearing floors and electrical installations.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) — official national tax authority portal at https://www.eta.gov.eg; e-invoicing clearance portal at https://einvoicing.eta.gov.eg; National Single Window for Foreign Trade 'Nafeza' used for customs export declarations and trade facilitation.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned Egyptian LLC obtains its statutory tax identity through the GAFI one-stop-shop procedure: (1) incorporate the LLC in the Commercial Registry and obtain the commercial registration certificate; (2) file the incorporation documents and legal address with the Egyptian Tax Authority to obtain the unified Tax Identification Number (TIN) and tax card; (3) register for VAT under Law No. 67 of 2016 within 30 days of reaching the EGP 500,000 annual taxable-turnover threshold, or immediately upon voluntary registration; (4) register on the ETA/Nafeza platform for electronic invoicing and customs identity; and (5) open a corporate EGP and foreign-currency bank account with an Egyptian bank to receive and evidence export proceeds in hard currency.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Egypt has no US-style check-the-box election and no hybrid mismatch election; tax classification is determined by the legal form. Available statutory elections for the LLC include voluntary VAT registration below the statutory threshold, election of investment-incentive deductions and Free Zone status under Investment Law No. 72/2017 subject to GAFI approval, and taxation on an approved accounting-period or cash basis as permitted by the Tax Procedures Law. Consolidated corporate tax returns are not permitted for Egyptian LLCs.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under Law No. 67 of 2016, administered by the Egyptian Tax Authority
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Mandatory VAT registration at EGP 500,000 annual taxable turnover of goods and services; voluntary registration is permitted below this threshold. Zero-rated export supplies count toward the turnover threshold for registration testing. Non-resident suppliers of electronic services are subject to separate ETA registration rules.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: ETA e-invoicing is mandatory for all VAT-registered businesses on B2B transactions. Each invoice must be transmitted in near-real-time (statutorily within 24 hours of issuance) via the ETA API in JSON/XML format, cleared by the central clearance portal, and digitally stamped with the ETA QR code before legal effectiveness. Invoices that are not cleared or stamped are not deductible by counterparties and expose the issuer to administrative fines. B2C e-receipts are being rolled out in phases for retail transactions.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: The LLC may apply the 0% VAT export rate where: (i) the physical goods are declared in the National Single Window and actually leave Egypt within 90 days of the supply/invoice date or within an ETA-approved extended window; (ii) a valid customs export declaration, export commercial invoice, and transport document evidence the removal; (iii) the buyer's full consideration is paid in freely convertible foreign currency and credited to the LLC's Egyptian bank account within the Central Bank of Egypt's 180-day export-proceeds repatriation deadline; and (iv) the LLC files zero-rated VAT returns with complete supporting documentation. Failure to achieve the 90-day export results in reclassification as a domestic 14% VAT supply with reversal of input VAT credits.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (lodged and cleared through the National Single Window for Foreign Trade 'Nafeza')
Commercial Export Invoice clearly stating the 0% VAT rate
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical departure from Egypt
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank statement evidencing hard-currency proceeds credited to the Egyptian bank account
Packing List and Certificate of Origin (as required by destination-country customs)
Foreign sales contract or purchase order (retained for ETA audit evidence)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The ETA may retrospectively audit export zero-rating claims for up to five years, cross-checking Nafeza customs declarations, cleared e-invoices, transport documents, and CBE inward-remittance statements. Where the required export documentation bundle is incomplete or the foreign-currency consideration is not repatriated within the 180-day deadline, zero-rating is clawed back retroactively: the LLC is reassessed at 14% VAT on the export invoice, input VAT credits are reversed, and late-payment interest plus administrative fines are imposed. Forgery or deliberate misrepresentation of customs, transport, or banking evidence is prosecuted as tax evasion under VAT Law No. 67 of 2016 and the Customs Law, carrying criminal sanctions including imprisonment, financial penalties, and suspension of e-invoicing privileges.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Egypt (CBE), acting as the unified regulatory authority for banking conduct, foreign-exchange administration, and clearing system supervision under Banking Law No. 194 of 2020.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Egypt maintains liberalized current-account convertibility for trade in goods and services under the unified exchange-rate regime adopted on 6 March 2024. Capital-account flows, including foreign equity injection, shareholder loans, and profit repatriation, are permitted but remain documentary-controlled and must be executed through CBE-licensed authorized banks. The Egyptian pound (EGP) is a market-discovered interbank currency subject to depreciation pressure; profit remittances require tax clearance from the Egyptian Tax Authority and the servicing bank's confirmed FX liquidity position. No systematic blockage exists on current-account payments, but banks may prioritize outbound transactions based on prevailing USD/EUR liquidity.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Exporters must repatriate 100% of export proceeds into Egypt through a CBE-licensed authorized bank within 120 days from the date of the shipping document (bill of lading). As of the March 2024 FX liberalization, there is no mandatory surrender or conversion ratio; exporters may retain proceeds in USD or EUR, apply them to import payments, or sell them at the interbank market rate. Non-compliance with the repatriation window triggers CBE penalties and elevated tax-audit scrutiny.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational EGP/USD account; Capital Escrow account for investor capital registration
Operational multi-currency account; trade finance and treasury facilities
Operational EGP/USD account; interbank FX and import settlement desk

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Low as primary treasury infrastructure; Medium as an ancillary collection layer for Shopify Payments and Stripe settlements. Offshore digital EMIs (including Wise, Airwallex, Payoneer, and Stripe Treasury) hold no CBE license, cannot maintain onshore EGP accounts, and cannot execute domestic FX or participate in the Egyptian interbank clearing system. They may intermediate cross-border e-commerce receipts in USD/EUR, but the LLC remains legally obligated to repatriate export proceeds through authorized CBE banks within the statutory window, making a local bank account mandatory for final settlement.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence and branch-level interview are mandated for foreign-owned LLCs. The general manager or an authorized signatory must appear in person before a CBE compliance officer for biometric verification and signatory activation; remote opening is generally not permitted for non-resident principals. Where a director cannot travel to Egypt, a notarized power of attorney legalized by the Egyptian consulate, together with apostilled corporate documents from the shareholder's jurisdiction, is required. Select banks accept video-KYC for Egyptian-resident minority shareholders only.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Newly formed LLC with less than 12 months of audited financial statements and projected high-volume e-commerce revenue
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified memorandum and articles of association; commercial registry extract (English and Arabic); tax card; registered office lease; board resolution appointing signatories; 12-month cash-flow forecast and business plan; supplier contracts with plastic-resin vendors; Shopify and Stripe merchant statements evidencing settlement history and marketplace registration.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident corporate shareholder or UBO chain with remittances originating from outside Egypt
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Completed UBO declaration; passport copies of all natural-person owners; apostilled certificate of incorporation and certificate of good standing for each corporate shareholder; bank reference letter from the remitting financial institution; source-of-wealth and source-of-funds statements supporting the capital injection; CBE inward capital transfer registration forms.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border retail sales to multiple countries raising sanctions exposure and high-risk jurisdiction flags
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: OFAC, EU, and UN sanctions screening reports for all commercial partners; IP geo-blocking policy excluding sanctioned territories; customer due diligence for wholesale orders above USD 10,000; export customs declarations; bill-of-lading and airway-bill documentation; annual export revenue reconciliation to settlement ledgers.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Shopify and Stripe acting as merchants of record, obscuring the Egyptian LLC as the beneficial seller
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed PSP agreements identifying the LLC as the commercial merchant and principal partner; settlement bank statements showing sweeps to the Egyptian bank account; electronic reconciliation of purchase orders, invoices, and monthly PSP settlement reports; direct contractual obligations with end customers and international delivery carriers.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Foreign shareholder wires USD or EUR via SWIFT MT103 to the LLC's foreign-currency account at an authorized Egyptian bank under CBE inward remittance codes for direct investment equity or shareholder loans. The servicing bank issues a funds transfer receipt; the LLC amends its commercial registry to reflect the capital increase; and the Egyptian Tax Authority is notified for investor registration. Injected funds may be converted to EGP at the interbank market rate or retained in USD to fund subsequent import payments, with full source verification maintained for AML and future profit-remittance traceability.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: International supplier payments for PBT resin and molds are executed via SWIFT MT103 direct transfers through correspondent banks, commercial Letters of Credit (MT700 sight or usance) opened by the Egyptian servicing bank, or cash-against-documents (CAD) collection. All disbursements require CBE purpose-code declarations for imports of raw materials, supported by invoices, packing lists, and transport documents. Domestic EGP disbursements settle through the CBE RTGS and the Instant Payment Network for payroll, VAT payments, and local logistics.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable FX forwards up to 12 months on export receivables and import payables, priced by CBE-licensed banks in the interbank market
Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) available only to foreign counterparties; Egyptian-resident companies are restricted from entering onshore NDFs
Cross-currency swaps (USD/EGP and EUR/EGP) and interest-rate swaps executed with CBE-licensed banks for eligible underlying trade or capital obligations

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Tax Card (Corporate Identity Card) annual renewal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fixed fine under Tax Law 91/2005; restricted access to government transactions and customs clearance; tax card suspension until renewal.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return with audited financial statements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 4 months after fiscal year end; for a calendar-year entity, by 30 April
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing fine of EGP 500–5,000 per return plus 2% monthly delay penalty on unpaid tax; persistent default triggers enforced collection, asset liens and suspension of tax card.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Monthly payroll salary tax and withholding tax returns
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: By the 15th day of the month following the month of deduction
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-return fine of EGP 500–5,000 and 2% monthly delay penalty; employer remains liable for unremitted withheld amounts.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: By the 30th day of the month following the tax period
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Statutory delay fines and monthly interest for unpaid VAT; recurrent non-filing can trigger VAT registration suspension and criminal penalties.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual financial statements approval by members and completion of statutory audit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Shareholders' General Assembly; audited copy filed as annex to the CIT return and kept available for GAFI/Commercial Registry inspection
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months after fiscal year end; for a calendar-year entity, by 30 June
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Directors and managers may be held personally liable for failure to convene the annual members' meeting; ETA may assess tax based on estimated income; banking facilities may be suspended.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Commercial Registry annual confirmation fee payment and 5-year certificate renewal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI), Commercial Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual fee due on the incorporation anniversary; full certificate renewal every 5 years
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Imposition of administrative late fees, suspension of the commercial register record, and administrative strike-off/deregistration after prolonged non-compliance.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Updates within 30 days of any shareholding or control change; confirmed at the annual commercial registry renewal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines under the AML Law No. 80/2002 (as amended) and restrictions on registry transactions until the UBO record is corrected.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory for all Egyptian limited liability companies without any turnover or asset exemption: Companies Law No. 159/1981 requires every LLC to appoint at least one licensed statutory auditor, and audited financial statements must support the annual CIT return. Sector-specific audit regimes apply to banks, insurance and listed companies.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Egyptian Accounting Standards (EAS), closely aligned with IFRS; fully IFRS as adopted is required for listed companies and financial institutions.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Beneficial owner data is registered with the Commercial Registry/GAFI at incorporation and must be updated within 30 days of any shareholding transfer or control change. There is no standalone UBO annual return; the register is re-confirmed during the annual Commercial Registry renewal and inspected by AML supervisory authorities.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book of shareholders' and managers' resolutions

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 22.5% for private-sector resident limited liability companies
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No statutory tax holiday for ISIC 3240 unless the LLC is licensed under the Investment Law (Law 72/2017) or located in a Free Zone/SCZone; eligible capital expenditure in approved manufacturing projects may attract a 30%–50% investment cost deduction; export-oriented Free Zone profits may be CIT-exempt if reinvested.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form No. 13 (Corporate Tax Return) filed via the Egyptian Tax Authority's online e-portal at tax.gov.eg; consolidated unified tax return procedures apply to all federal taxes.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual return with four quarterly provisional CIT instalments during the same tax year.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The annual return must be submitted within four months after the close of the fiscal year; quarterly advance CIT payments are due within one month after the end of each calendar quarter of the fiscal year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name, Tax Identification Number (TIN), fiscal year, registered address, authorised representative details, and filing status.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert the Egyptian TIN and registration number obtained when establishing the Egyptian LLC; indicate that the entity is a non-resident wholly/partially owned LLC taxed on Egyptian-source income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross invoiced proceeds from all commercial activity, including export sales and online sales of custom mechanical keyboard caps.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Declare Egypt-source sales allocable to the Egyptian LLC/PE on an accrual basis; exclude sales that are incontestably concluded and performed wholly outside Egypt and not attributable to an Egyptian permanent establishment.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Raw material costs for PBT/ABS pellets, double-shot plastic-injection tooling, engraving, moulding consumables, and direct labour.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Deduct costs only to the extent attributable to the Egyptian PE activity and supported by invoices, customs declarations, and inventory records.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Shopify subscription, Stripe processing fees, packaging, warehousing, salaries, rent, utilities, insurance, and professional fees.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Claim expenses that are wholly and exclusively incurred for earning taxable income in Egypt; cross-charged group expenses must satisfy Egyptian transfer-pricing documentation requirements.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax depreciation of plastic injection machines, moulds, office equipment, and intangible assets (software, product design).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply the statutory rates and no accelerated deductions without prior approval; capital allowances must correspond to assets physically used in the Egyptian PE.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Non-deductible expenses, gifts above legal limits, penalties, 50% of certain entertainment costs, and any transfer-pricing adjustment.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Same add-back rules apply to the PE; expenses reimbursed by the foreign head office without commercial substance must be added back.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 6 – Net Taxable Income after Losses
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income after offsetting deductible expenses and applying the 5-year loss carryforward restriction.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only losses incurred in the Egyptian PE may be carried forward; foreign head-office losses are never set off.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Apply the 22.5% statutory CIT rate to net taxable income and deduct prepaid quarterly instalments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Compute PE tax at the same 22.5% rate; there is no special lower PE rate unless a Double Tax Treaty provides an exemption for a specific service activity.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 8 – Annual Statement and Final Settlement
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Enter total tax due, quarterly instalments already paid, any treaty or domestic credit, and final amount payable or refundable.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach supporting schedules showing foreign transfer prices, Egyptian TP declaration, and any withholding tax certificates.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statutory certificate signed by the LLC general manager or authorised director confirming accuracy and completeness.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The authorised representative resident in Egypt must sign; the foreign non-resident director may co-sign if using a power of attorney.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing triggers a fixed penalty of EGP 1,000–10,000 plus monthly late-payment interest of 2% on outstanding CIT; false or aggressive under-reporting can lead to an additional tax assessment of up to double the evaded tax and criminal imprisonment up to five years.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% final withholding tax on distributions of profits from the Egyptian LLC to shareholders, including non-resident corporate shareholders.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Beneficial owner must obtain a valid Tax Residency Certificate from the jurisdiction of residence; the Egyptian LLC must submit the certificate, a Form 'DTA Relief Declaration', and evidence of shareholding to the Egyptian Tax Authority before the dividend remittance to apply the reduced treaty rate (commonly 5% for a shareholding of at least 25% or 10%/15% otherwise); any excess WHT withheld may be reclaimed through the foreign shareholder's annual refund application or mutual agreement procedure.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rates: 20% withholding tax on royalties and 20% on interest paid by an Egyptian LLC to non-residents; treaty rates under Egypt's double tax agreements range generally between 10% and 15% for interest and between 5% and 20% for royalties, subject to beneficial ownership and substance requirements.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: EGP 10 million in controlled transactions during the fiscal year triggers mandatory Local File preparation; Master File is required where the worldwide group has consolidated annual revenue exceeding EGP 200 million; Country-by-Country Reporting is compulsory when group consolidated revenue exceeds EGP 20 billion and the group operates in Egypt.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: No standalone Economic Substance Regulation of the UAE type exists in Egypt; however, the Income Tax Law imports a general anti-abuse rule requiring arrangements to have real commercial substance and economic justification. The Egyptian Tax Authority will treat a pure paper entity lacking staff, premises, or active business functions as not entitled to treaty relief on dividends, interest, or royalties and may also disregard transactions whose sole purpose is tax avoidance.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Corporate Income Tax Evasion / Double Accounting
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintenance of parallel sets of books, deliberate under-declaration of Shopify sales, or issuance of false invoices to shift Egyptian taxable profit outside Egypt.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Assessment of the full evaded tax plus a penalty equal to 100%–200% of the evaded amount, monthly late-payment interest, confiscation of assets, and criminal imprisonment up to five years under Law 91/2005.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the general manager who sign false returns are jointly and severally liable for the tax and penalties; the courts may impose travel bans, asset freezes, and a personal criminal sentence of up to five years, and may prohibit the director from holding board positions in Egypt.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Selling keycaps or substantial raw materials to an offshore affiliate at artificially low prices, paying excessive royalties to a related IP company with no economic activity, or failing to file the annual transfer-pricing declaration once the EGP 10 million controlled-transaction threshold is met.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Upward TP adjustment of taxable income, additional 22.5% CIT on the adjustment, monthly interest, and an administrative penalty of up to 25% of the adjusted tax payable.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly approve non-arm's-length contracts or direct the concealment of TP information may be personally joint- liable for the additional assessed taxes and subject to restraint orders and bank account garnishments during audit.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Interposition of a letter-box holding company in a treaty jurisdiction without actual office, employees, or operating activities to procure a 5% dividend treaty rate instead of the 10% or 20% Egyptian domestic rate.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Denial of treaty relief, reapplication of statutory withholding rates, assessment of unpaid WHT, late-payment interest, and a fine of up to 20% of the under-withheld tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The directors and beneficial owners who structured the sham arrangement can be made personally liable for the additional withholding tax; travel bans may be imposed during criminal investigation, and distributed funds may be seized if the arrangement is treated as money laundering.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Receiving Shopify or Stripe payouts into personal unlicensed bank accounts, using foreign digital wallets unattached to the corporate tax file, or keeping stock transfers in private commercial channels without bank documentation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines under Egyptian AML Law No. 80/2002 ranging from EGP 50,000 to EGP 500,000 and imprisonment up to five years; tax deductions supported solely by undisclosed mental contracts may be disallowed entirely.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally prosecutable for non-compliance with beneficiary due diligence and for deliberately routing corporate funds through their personal accounts; during a criminal case the court may order a travel ban, house arrest, and seizure of the personal assets of the directors.
